about: Security findings a person has reviewed and judged safe. The security agent dismisses a matching GitHub alert (same rule, same file) with this reason, so the tracker closes it and the reasoning stays in git. A new finding of a different rule, or in a different file, is never covered. Remove an entry to reopen the question.
